stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Job Agent v2.9.6 beta fixes two regressions found from real v2.9.5 search logs: (1) analytics, data, reporting and PowerBI internship/trainee titles are recognized as expanded entry-level opportunities, with existing strong-evidence and data-skill safety gates retained, rather than being incorrectly discarded as unrelated; (2) the agent's startup journal reads the packaged version.json so the runtime version matches the installed release, instead of always saying v2.9.1. Five actual manual submissions were confirmed in the prior run; final employer Submit stays manual. GitHub Actions: 48 offline tests passed.
